daily limit code 61 found during a decline review
debit card declined at a store

when.quote: If your debit card was declined due to balance-related reasons, you may have encountered one of these codes:

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer says a debit card was declined. Read the records and run the checks below, in order. Each fix (unfreeze, clearing an alert or velocity block, a temporary limit increase, a transfer between the customer's own accounts) is offered only when its check finds that cause, and is made only after the customer says yes. A bank-initiated alert is transferred to security without an offer, as the document says.
starts.quote: If status is FROZEN → Ask customer if they want to unfreeze. If yes, follow the freezing/unfreezing card protocol.

tools.not_used: A decline review never freezes a card. Freezing belongs to freezing_and_unfreezing_a_debit_card, chip_cvv_mismatch_card_review and the card action after a dispute.
Only for a customer who wants to deposit a check now. Explaining when an already-deposited check becomes available needs no tool.
Only for a PENDING card. This job hands that off to activating_a_debit_card.
Only for a PENDING replacement card. Handed off to activating_a_debit_card.
Only for a PENDING reissued card. Handed off to activating_a_debit_card.
A replacement for a CLOSED or expired card is ordered in order_replacement_debit_card.

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. These must match the records.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me two of the following: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: The decline code shown at the terminal, if the customer saw one
info.ask: Did you see a decline code or message on the terminal?

info.about: How the purchase was made: in store (chip, PIN or signature), online, or at an ATM
info.ask: Were you paying in person, online, or at an ATM?
How much was the purchase you were trying to make?

info.about: Which checking account or debit card was declined, if the customer has more than one
info.ask: Which of your checking accounts is the card linked to?

info.about: Recent merchant authorization holds the customer knows of (gas, hotel, car rental, restaurant)
info.ask: Have you had any recent gas, hotel, car rental or restaurant charges that might have placed a hold on your funds?

info.about: The customer's reason for unusual recent activity, if the card has a velocity block
info.ask: Our system saw an unusual pattern of activity on this card. Can you tell me about your recent purchases?

info.about: Whether the customer wants to move money from another of their own accounts, from which account, and how much
info.ask: Would you like to transfer funds from another of your accounts? If so, which account and how much?

info.about: status, fraud_alert_active, alert_source, velocity_blocked, issue_reason, expiration_date, limits and date_issued for the card
Checking account status, balance, date_opened and overdraft_pos_enabled
Pending transactions and recent check or mobile deposits on the account

steps.do: Greet the customer and ask for 2 of: DOB, email, phone, address
steps.quote: ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address

steps.do: Look up the customer's records

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email / _by_id)

steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools

steps.do: Compare the values the customer gave with the record from lookup_user. Continue only if at least 2 of date of birth, email, phone and address match. Share nothing about the accounts before that. If they do not match, ask again; if they still do not match, say you cannot verify the customer and stop.
steps.quote: Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log
steps.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

steps.do: Log the verification
steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Ask for the decline code (if seen), the channel, the amount and which account or card was declined. If the customer saw no code, run every check below in order.
steps.quote: This is a catch-all code that requires investigation. Check the following IN ORDER:

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get the customer's accounts (status, balance, date_opened, overdraft_pos_enabled)
steps.quote: Look up the customer's accounts to get the checking account balance.

steps.do: Unlock the debit card lookup tool
steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: Get the debit cards for the checking account in question and check status, flags and issue_reason
steps.quote: Look up the debit card information and check the card's status field.

steps.do: Unlock the account transaction history tool
steps.quote: Agents can retrieve the transaction history for a customer's bank account (checking or savings) using the get_bank_account_transactions_9173 tool.

steps.do: Get account transactions and look for pending items and recent check/mobile deposits
steps.quote: Review recent transaction history and look for transactions with status 'pending'.

steps.do: Route by code or findings. Not-active status, fraud alert or velocity block: follow Code 05 / security alert rules (check_card_status through clear_velocity below). Card reported stolen: job reported_stolen_card_decline. Chip error: job chip_cvv_mismatch_card_review. Balance short: next step.
steps.quote: If status is ACTIVE → Continue to step 2.

steps.do: If the terminal said to keep or pick up the card, or the decline is a pick-up or suspected-fraud decline (codes 04/07/34/59), never tell the customer the card is flagged for fraud. Say only that transactions on this card cannot be processed and they should visit a branch with valid ID; transfer only if they press for details. If the card record shows it was reported stolen, go to reported_stolen_card_decline; if reported lost, ask whether they reported it (see that job's lost branch).
steps.if: the customer reports a keep-card/pick-up/stolen message, or the card record shows it reported lost or stolen
steps.quote: Say: 'I'm sorry, but I'm unable to process transactions on this card. For assistance, please visit a Rho-Bank branch with valid ID.' Use transfer_to_human_agents if customer presses for details.

steps.do: Check the card's status from get_cards. FROZEN: tell the customer and ask whether they want it unfrozen. CLOSED: tell them the card is no longer active, check get_cards for another active card, or offer a replacement (order_replacement_debit_card). PENDING: the card is not activated yet; go to activating_a_debit_card. ACTIVE: continue.
steps.quote: If status is CLOSED → Inform customer this card is no longer active. Check if they have another active card or offer to order a replacement.

steps.do: Unlock unfreeze_debit_card_3893, then call it with the card's card_id. Confirm the card is active and ready to use, then continue to the next check. If the call errors, explain and offer a transfer (transfer_if_error).
steps.if: the card status is FROZEN, its linked checking account is OPEN, and the customer says yes to unfreezing
steps.quote: 4. The linked checking account must still be OPEN

steps.do: Check the linked checking account's status from get_accounts. If it is not OPEN, say only: 'Your account has a restriction that is preventing transactions. Please visit a branch or call our dedicated account services line at 1-800-RHO-ACCT for assistance.' Give no details for SUSPENDED or RESTRICTED, and stop the diagnosis.
steps.if: the card is ACTIVE or was just unfrozen
steps.quote: Inform customer their account has a restriction. DO NOT provide specific details if status is SUSPENDED or RESTRICTED.

steps.do: Check fraud_alert_active and alert_source from get_cards. customer_initiated: read the recent transactions from get_txns and ask the customer to confirm each one. bank_initiated: do not clear it (bank_alert_transfer). If the customer denies any transaction, do not clear the alert and offer a dispute (filing_a_debit_card_transaction_dispute).
steps.quote: If fraud_alert_active is TRUE and alert_source is 'customer_initiated' → Ask customer to verify recent transactions. If they confirm all transactions are legitimate, clear the alert.

steps.do: Unlock clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892 and clear the customer-initiated alert with reason customer_verified. If it returns an error, transfer to the security team (bank_alert_transfer).
steps.if: fraud_alert_active is TRUE, alert_source is customer_initiated, and the customer confirms ALL recent transactions are theirs
steps.quote: Use when clearing a customer-initiated fraud alert after the customer has verified their identity and confirmed their transactions are legitimate

steps.do: Do not clear the alert. Say: 'I see there's a security flag on your account that requires additional review. I'm transferring you to our security team.' Then call transfer_to_human_agents with reason fraud_or_security_concern.

args.summary: verified customer; debit card declined; bank-initiated fraud alert on the card

steps.if: fraud_alert_active is TRUE and alert_source is bank_initiated, or clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892 returned an error
steps.quote: Do NOT clear it. Say: 'I see there's a security flag on your account that requires additional review. I'm transferring you to our security team.' Then transfer to human agents.

steps.do: Check velocity_blocked from get_cards. If TRUE, read the scripted message, ask whether to lift it now, and ask about the recent activity.
steps.quote: If velocity_blocked is TRUE, inform customer: 'Your card was temporarily blocked because our security system detected unusual activity patterns. This block automatically lifts after 30 minutes. Would you like me to verify your identity and lift it now?'

steps.do: Unlock clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892 (if not already) and clear the velocity block with reason velocity_clear.
steps.if: velocity_blocked is TRUE, the customer wants it lifted now, and gives a reasonable explanation for the activity
steps.quote: For velocity blocks: Customer provides a reasonable explanation for the unusual activity (e.g., shopping spree, travel)

steps.do: Compare the card's expiration_date (get_cards) with get_time_verif. If expired, look for another card with issue_reason expired: PENDING → activating_a_debit_card; ACTIVE → direct the customer to the new card; none → order one in order_replacement_debit_card.
steps.quote: Verify expiration: Look up the debit card information and check expiration_date field.

steps.do: Compare the attempted amount with daily_purchase_limit minus daily_purchase_used (daily ATM fields for an ATM) from get_cards. If the limit caused the decline, tell the customer the limit, the amount used and what remains, and offer a 24-hour temporary increase.
steps.quote: Transaction exceeds the card's daily purchase or ATM limit. Check limits from the debit card lookup:

steps.do: Unlock request_temporary_debit_card_limit_increase_8374 and request the increase. If any eligibility check fails, explain which one and do not call.

arguments.limit_type: purchase or atm, per the declined transaction
arguments.new_limit: the amount the customer needs, at most 150% of the current limit from get_cards

steps.if: the limit caused the decline, the customer accepts the offer, the account is OPEN and at least 60 days old, there is no overdraft_fee in the last 30 days, the card is ACTIVE, the account is not a Light Green Account, and no temporary increase was made in the last 24 hours
steps.quote: New limit cannot exceed 150% of current limit (50% boost maximum)

steps.do: Compare the checking balance (get_accounts) with the attempted amount, then subtract pending debits from get_txns. Treat a recent check_deposit or mobile_deposit that is pending, or only partly available, as not yet spendable. Decide: available funds below the amount → explain_insufficient; otherwise → auth_holds.
steps.quote: Pending card transactions and checks can decrease available funds before they appear as posted.

steps.do: Tell the customer their available balance. Explain that pending items and recently deposited checks may not be available yet: standard deposits are typically available within 1-2 business days, and some deposits get extended review. The expected availability date shows in the app.
steps.if: available balance is below the attempted amount
steps.quote: Pending card transactions and checks can decrease available funds before they appear as posted.

steps.do: Give the deposit availability timeline
steps.if: a recent check or mobile deposit is part of the expected funds
steps.quote: Certain deposits may be subject to extended review. You will see the expected availability date in the app after submission.

steps.do: If the customer asks to get the deposited funds sooner, explain that no documented action releases a deposit early. Do not promise faster availability. Offer the documented options instead (offer_options): a transfer from another of their own accounts, a smaller purchase, or waiting until the funds become available.
steps.if: the customer asks for faster access to a deposit that is not yet available
steps.quote: Add funds or transfer money from another account to restore a positive available balance.

steps.do: Offer to transfer funds from another of the customer's accounts, or to make a smaller transaction
steps.quote: Offer options: 'Would you like to transfer funds from another account, or would you prefer to make a smaller transaction?'

steps.do: Unlock, then call transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 from the customer's chosen source account to the declined checking account for the amount they confirm
steps.if: customer asks to transfer funds from another Rho-Bank account that has the money available, both accounts belong to the customer and are OPEN or ACTIVE (get_accounts), and the source's balance covers the amount
steps.quote: If they want to transfer, help them do so.

steps.do: If the transfer returns an error (for example, insufficient funds in the source account), tell the customer it did not go through and why. Retry only if the customer chooses a different amount or source. If the error cannot be resolved, offer a human agent and transfer only if they agree.
steps.quote: The tool will return an error if the source account has insufficient funds.

steps.do: If the balance appears sufficient, ask whether the customer has recent authorization holds (gas, hotel, car rental, restaurant). Explain that holds reduce the available balance and typically release in 1-3 business days, and name any pending debits from get_txns.
steps.if: the balance appears sufficient for the attempted amount
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they have any recent authorization holds that might be reducing their available balance.

steps.do: If the balance looked sufficient but overdraft_pos_enabled is FALSE, explain the overdraft opt-in options
steps.if: balance appears sufficient and overdraft_pos_enabled is FALSE
steps.quote: If overdraft_pos_enabled is FALSE: 'Your account isn't opted into overdraft coverage for debit card purchases. Would you like me to explain your options?'

steps.do: If an unfreeze, clear or limit-increase call returns an error that cannot be resolved, explain what failed and ask whether the customer wants a human agent. Transfer (technical_system_error) only if they say yes.

args.summary: the card checked, the action attempted and the error

steps.if: a fix call returned an unresolvable error and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request

steps.do: Once the decline is explained, if the customer raises another card problem (a chip error, a card reported stolen, a dispute), go to that job and reuse this verification; do not verify again.
steps.if: the customer raises another issue in this conversation
steps.quote: No need to verify more than once in a single conversation.

rules.rule: Verify identity with 2 of DOB, email, phone or address before discussing account data, then log the verification.
rules.quote: Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

rules.rule: Code 05 / unknown decline: check card status, then account status, then fraud alert, then velocity block, in that order.
rules.quote: This is a catch-all code that requires investigation. Check the following IN ORDER:

rules.rule: If the account status is SUSPENDED or RESTRICTED, do not give specifics. Refer the customer to a branch or 1-800-RHO-ACCT.
rules.quote: DO NOT provide specific details if status is SUSPENDED or RESTRICTED.

rules.rule: Only a customer_initiated fraud alert can be cleared, after the customer confirms their transactions. A bank_initiated alert is not cleared; transfer the customer to the security team.
rules.quote: IMPORTANT: If fraud_alert_active is TRUE and alert_source is 'bank_initiated' → Do NOT clear it.

rules.rule: A velocity block may be lifted early with clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892 (reason 'velocity_clear') after verification.
rules.quote: `'velocity_clear'`: Use when clearing a velocity block after verifying the customer's identity

rules.rule: Never tell the customer that a card is fraud-flagged (codes 04/07/34/59).
rules.quote: This could tip off a fraudster who has stolen the card.

rules.rule: Do not claim the card is broken or frozen when the cause is available balance. Explain the balance or hold.
A card can be unfrozen only if it is FROZEN and its linked checking account is OPEN.
rules.quote: 4. The linked checking account must still be OPEN

rules.rule: Bank-initiated alerts cannot be cleared by the agent; the tool returns an error.
rules.quote: This tool CANNOT clear bank-initiated fraud alerts.

rules.rule: Deposited funds: standard deposits are typically available within 1-2 business days; some get extended review with the date shown in the app.
rules.quote: Funds availability depends on the account type and deposit amount. Standard deposits are typically available within 1-2 business days.

rules.rule: A temporary limit increase needs an OPEN account at least 60 days old, no overdraft fees in 30 days and an ACTIVE card; at most one per card per 24 hours, up to 150% of the current limit.
rules.quote: No overdraft fees in the last 30 days

rules.rule: Only one temporary increase per card in 24 hours.
rules.quote: Only one temporary increase per 24-hour period per card

rules.rule: A transfer between the customer's accounts needs both accounts OPEN or ACTIVE and enough available funds in the source.
rules.quote: Confirm both the source and destination accounts are in ACTIVE or OPEN status

rules.rule: Security transfers use the Tier 1 reason fraud_or_security_concern.
rules.quote: Fraud, identity theft, unauthorized transactions, or security concerns requiring specialist handling

done_when: The customer is verified and logged. Every check has been run in order (card status, account status, fraud alert, velocity block, expiry, limit, available balance). The decline cause has been identified from the card and account records and explained, with deposit availability timing where relevant and no promise of faster access. Any fix the customer agreed to (unfreeze, alert or block cleared, limit increase, transfer) is done or explained as ineligible, or the customer was transferred for a bank-initiated alert. Any further issue the customer raised has been routed to its job.
